verdict.rationale: Unit's own docs claim a native ledger with real-time balances and transaction data, plus settlement-level transaction visibility. A first-party 'Webhook Events' API docs page exists, so the core event-driven ledger is documented. However, the pack only shows the webhook page title, not which events it covers. Missing for 10: evidence that balance reads reflect holds and pending activity, documentation of the webhook event catalog covering every transaction state change, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
